citations.assessment: The continuation concerns a custodian and an object returned after use. The two versions both name bar Pappa, first objecting and then corroborating. The link opens the earlier named occurrence.
The garden seed did not sprout until he prayed and rain came. This is not the separate custodian notice.
R. Naḥum bar Pappa directly reports R. Elazar HaKappar on the crimson strip. Preserve Naḥum distinctly from the entry heading.
The linked entry and one Bava Metzia attribution give the inverse patronymic. The other attribution is Pappa son of Rav Yosef. The comparison does not establish Heilprin's suggested parentage.
